title: The SECRET Entry Model Smart Money Traders Don’t Talk About | FVG Explained 🔑

entry_sequence.action: Identify a trend with high momentum.
entry_sequence.rationale: The probability of the trade playing out is higher when sticking to the trend.

entry_sequence.action: Wait for a break of structure (BOS) to occur.
entry_sequence.rationale: The imbalance must create a break of structure.

entry_sequence.action: Identify a Fair Value Gap (FVG) formed by three consecutive candlesticks.
entry_sequence.rationale: The gap is created between the closing point of the first candle and the opening point of the third candle.

entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to retrace and tap into the FVG.
entry_sequence.rationale: Price will most likely come back to mitigate the imbalance and keep pushing to the upside.

entry_sequence.action: Enter long when price taps the FVG.
entry_sequence.rationale: Price retraced just tapped in and continued to the upside.

entry_sequence.action: Enter short when price taps the FVG.
entry_sequence.rationale: Price will return to the FVG and drop more like how we catch entries using order block.

stop.rationale: Put your stop loss a little bit below the fair value gap.
